writing.exampleCaption: Tests live beside the code and can see its private parts.
writing.explanation: #[test] functions are compiled only for the test harness, so they cost nothing in a release build. Unit tests sit beside the code and can reach its private details; integration tests live in tests/ and see only the public API, which is a useful check on your own interface.
